description: Windkraftmasterplan Ausschlusszone Oberösterreich is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ags.doris.at. Exclusion zone of the Upper Austrian Wind Power Master Plan 2017. Zones that are not suitable for wind power use, because essential negative effects on individual technical criteria are to be expected. This dataset is made available via INSPIRE. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Wind power master plan Exclusion zone Upper Austria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Internetfreigabe, Energie, Wind, Windenergie, Windkraftmasterplan, Energiequellen. The listing shows 5 download or service links in WFS, ATOM, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
